SELECT /*LGVATT00013.retrieveOsKpiStandard*/ kos.kpi_os_standard_no ,kos.ITEM_NO ,kos.ITEM_NAME ,kos.PERFECT_TARGET ,kos.PERFECT_POINT ,kos.ACTUAL_TARGET ,kos.ACTUAL_POINT ,kos.CRITERIA ,(select local_language_full_name from lgcom_user_m where application_user_id = kos.creation_user_id) as creation_user_id /* 등록자ID */ ,TO_CHAR(kos.creation_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') as creation_date /* 등록일자 */ FROM TB_PAY_KPI_OS_STANDARD kos WHERE 1 = 1
AND (UPPER(kos.item_name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{itemName}) || '%')
ORDER BY kos.kpi_os_standard_no, kos.ITEM_NO asc
